results.description:
# What’s the Carer Payment and am I eligible?
## What is the income and assets test for the Carer Payment?
### 2. Assets test for carer payments
|  | **Homeowner** | **Non-homeowner** |
|-|-|-|
| Single | $333,000 | $745,750 | $600,000 | $1,012,750 |
| Couple combined | $499,000 | $1,121,000 | $766,000 | $1,388,000 |
| Couple separated due to illness, combined | $499,000 | $1,324,500 | $766,000 | $1,591,500 |
| Couple, one person eligible, combined | $499,000 | $1,121,000 | $766,000 | $1,388,000 |

## How much is the Carer Payment and is it taxed?
| **Carer Payment rate per fortnight** | **Single** | **Couple (each person)** | **Couple (combined)** | **Couple (each person when separated due to ill health)** |
|-|-|-|-|-|
| Maximum basic rate | $1,135.40 | $855.90 | $1,711.80 | $1,135.40 |
| Maximum pension supplement | $88.20 | $66.50 | $133.00 | $88.20 |
| Energy supplement | $14.10 | $10.60 | $21.20 | $14.10 |
| **Total** | **$1,237.70** | **$933.00** | **$1,866.00** | **$1,237.70** |
